precision: float64 for the Taylor and central-difference checks
backend: cuda for tests/test_mode_branches.py, tests/test_mode_network.py and tests/test_mode_branch_passivity.py when CUDA and CuPy are present, else cpu

physics_configuration.materials: core permittivity 12, cladding 2.1, guide width 0.4 um, wavelength 1.55 um, 0.5 um z-periodic slab, float32
physics_configuration.straight_guide: tests/test_mode_branches.py: 4.8 x 2.4 x 0.5 um, mesh 0.1 um, x CPML 8 layers, y and z periodic, 600 steps, aperture ports (0, 1.2, 0.5) um at x = -1 and +1 um with source offset 0.4 um; tests/test_mode_network.py: 8 x 1 x 1 um, mesh 0.2 um, 40x5x5 cells, 600 steps, full-cell two-port network
physics_configuration.y_branch_and_crossing_at_0p1um: tests/test_mode_branches.py: 4.8 x 4.8 x 0.5 um, mesh 0.1 um, 48x48x5 cells, x and y CPML 8 layers (0.8 um), 800 steps (152 fs), Y branch with arms moving from y = 0 at x = -0.4 um to y = +-0.7 um at x = 0.6 um and three ports (in at x = -1, up and down at x = +1, y = +-0.7 um); crossing of two 0.4 um guides with four ports at x = +-1 and y = +-1 um; 2-cycle Gaussian plane launch; device cuda when available else cpu
physics_configuration.y_branch_and_crossing_at_0p05um: tests/test_mode_branch_passivity.py: the same physical geometry, ports and launch at mesh 0.05 um (96x96x10 cells), CPML 16 layers (0.8 um), 2400 steps (229 fs, dt = 9.533e-17 s); a closed box of four full-extent FieldMonitor planes through the x = +-1 um port planes and y = +-1.4 um (Y branch) or y = +-1 um (crossing), fed by prepare_aperture_modal_launch and ModeInjectedPlaneSimulation with the network's own input-port launch; the incident power is the west-plane flux of the straight calibration guide with the same launch
physics_configuration.discontinuity: tests/test_mode_network_unequal.py: two-port network with exterior permittivities 1.0 and 1.44 (index step 1.0 to 1.2), 40x5x5 cells of 0.2 um, 600 steps, CPU; benchmarks/mode_network_unequal_cpml.py 12 um guide with 15-cell CPML against a scalar discrete Yee interface oracle
physics_configuration.pml: 0.8 um CPML on the open axes of the branch fixtures; 15 cells in the unequal-port benchmark

reference_method: Physical invariants of a lossless reciprocal structure: reciprocity S_ij = S_ji after unit reduced-power normalisation of every channel at the port phase planes, passivity sum_j |S_ji|^2 <= 1, and the complete channel balance of the Poynting flux through a closed box (incident = reflected + transmitted + side radiation) measured without the modal projection. Straight-guide phase against exp(2 i beta L) from the mode solver's beta (analytic_discrete). Discontinuity |S|^2 against continuum Fresnel R and T and the complex S against an independently coded scalar discrete Yee interface. S^H S = I is never asserted for an open network.

observables.name: column_power
observables.definition: sum over selected guided channels of |S_ji|^2 for each incident channel i (report column_power); the defect 1 - column_power is the power missing from the guided channels

observables.name: flux_closure
observables.definition: sum of the outward Poynting flux fractions through the four box faces (west inward incident counted negative); zero for a closed box when all power has left

observables.name: guided_versus_total
observables.definition: |S_00|^2 against the total reflected fraction 1 + west/incident; sum of arm |S_j0|^2 against the total flux fraction through the arm-carrying faces

observables.name: measured_nonguided
observables.definition: (reflected_total - |S_00|^2) + (transmitted_total - guided transmission) + side radiation; equals the defect minus the closure error identically

observables.name: fresnel_powers
observables.definition: |S_ii|^2 against R = 1/121 and |S_21|^2 against T = 120/121 for the index step 1.0 to 1.2

material_vjp.cpu_float64_taylor: remainder ratio below 0.3 per halving and central difference within 1e-6 relative

acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds lossless_complete_channel_balance_absolute_error 0.01 for the flux closure; the other values are the repository's recorded budgets, all reported here as differences from the program's common criteria where looser
